tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: zhi khro na rag dong sprugs rnal 'byor gyi spyi khrus 'gyod tshangs kyi cho ga dri med bshags rgyud ces bya ba bzhugs so:

bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po la phya 'tshal lo: rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: skyo ngal med pa'i mtsho rgyal la: na rag gnas kyang dong sprugs pa'i: nyung 'dus man ngag zab mo 'di: rgyun gyi yi dam nar ma 'o: 'di yi phan yon bstan pa ni: rgyal ba dgongs pa 'dus pa yi: klong chen rgyud nas 'di skad gsungs: sgyu 'phrul rgyal ba zhi khro yi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs de dag gi: mtshan rnams lan gcig brjod byed na: mtshams med lnga yi sdig pa byang: dam tshig nyams chag sor chud nas: na rag gnas kyang dong nas sprugs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob: tshe 'dir bde legs phun sum tshogs: tshe 'das sku gdung ring bsrel 'byung: phyi ma rig 'dzin zhing du 'gro: de skad klong bshags rgyud nas gsungs: de phyir sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: nyams chag bskang phyir phyag 'tshal zhing: e ma ho: chos dbyings rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: phyogs bcu dus bzhi rgyal ba sras dang bcas: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du gshegs su gsol: rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: kun bzang chod pa'i sprin gyis mchod par bgyi: a la la ho: don dam chos dbyings yum gyi bha ga'i klong: mkha' dbyings yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po na: bzhugs pa'i phyogs bcu dus gsum bde bar gshegs: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: a la la ho: zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid rab tu 'phro: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem zhi ba'i tshul dgu ldan: sangs rgyas bzhi bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo: a la la ho: chos rnams rnam dag ye nas lhun grub cing: bya ba byed dang yid chos rnam par dag: chos dbyings ye shes mchog la mnga' brnyes pa: kun bzang yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo: chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang: gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal:

thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa: rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo: ngo mtshar pho brang bde bar gshegs pa'i yum: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed mdzad ma: bde stong zung 'jug yab kyi sku la 'khril: rigs kyi yum mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: rnam shes dbang po dag pas thugs dang gsung: bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras mchog ste: nyon mongs spyod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba yi: sems dpa' chen po brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar bcas: bdug spos me tog snang gsal dri chab ma: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod pas mnyes mdzad ma: mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: drag shul thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad cing: bdud kyi dpung dang bgegs tshogs rnam par 'joms: tshad med bzhi ldan sgo bzhi thub par srung: ta krita sgo ba bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo: rtag chad lta 'byin gsang ba yum gyi ngang: mi mthun phyogs 'joms rab 'jigs khro mo'i tshul: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma: ye shes sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo: steng 'og phyogs bzhi 'jig rten 'dul ba'i gtso: nyon mongs drug 'joms rgyud drug dag par sbyong: 'gro drug 'dren phyir sprul pa'i skur ston pa: bcom ldan thub pa drug la phyag 'tshal lo: a la la ho: sgyu 'phrul zhi ba'i lha tshogs 'di dag gi: mtshan ni lan gcig brjod byed cing: gang gis gus pas phyag 'tshal na: nyams chag bskangs nas dngos grub thob: de phyir gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: a la la ho: khro bo rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang: rgod dang gshe la khro bar bstan pa dang: snying rje rngams dang zhi bar skur ston pa: 'bar ba lnga bcu brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: a la la ho: chos sku skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs skur ston pa: gdug pa 'dul mdzad khro chen 'bar ba'i sku:

dpal chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: khro rgyal dbang phyug sku la 'khril mdzad cing: dgyes pa skyed phyir dung khrag yab la stob: khro mo mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ma: kro ti shwa rī yum la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs rje thabs mkhas ma rungs 'dul mdzad cing: ye shes mtshon chas nyon mongs ma lus 'joms: srid gsum bla med dbyings su sgrol mdzad pa: rigs bzhi khrag 'thung tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: khrag 'thung so so'i yab kyi sku la 'khril: khro mo'i gzugs kyis log lta zil gyis gnon: 'gro rnams thugs rjes 'dren phyir mdzad pa'i yum: rigs bzhi khro mo yum la phyag 'tshal lo: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: sgeg mo la sogs 'bar ba'i nyams ldan zhing: ye shes sku mchog 'jigs byed slas su bzhugs: ko'u rī khro mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs pa med: 'dod dgur sgyur ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che: ma sring byams pa'i tshul du grogs mdzad ma: sing ha phra men brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: rdo rje gdong mo pho nya mgyogs ma bzhi: 'gugs dang 'ching sdom myos pa'i las kun mdzad: shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi thub par bsrung: sgo srung khro mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo: dpal gyi 'khor tshogs badz+ra ā ral+li: mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro ma tshogs dbang phyug ma: srin mo'i cha lugs 'jigs pa'i mgo brnyan can: rnal 'byor nyi shu brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: phyogs bcu dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong: mi dge tshar gcod dge bcu don du bskul: phyogs bcu'i khro rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: a la la ho: sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'di dag gi: mtshan ni lan gcig brjod byed cing: gang gis gus pas phyag 'tshal na: nyams chag bskangs nas dngos grub thob: de phyir gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: a la la ho: dus gsum sangs rgyas yon tan kun rdzogs shing:

gdul bya ma lus smin cing grol mdzad pa: bla ma rigs 'dzin tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: skye med chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: cir yang sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mngon par byang chub sku la phyag 'tshal lo: dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bsgrub pa'i gnas: tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing yon tan mthar phyin pa: sku dang ye shes tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: 'byung ba lnga las skur bzhengs pa: rtag pa'i rgyal mo lnga la phyag 'tshal lo: rang bzhin dbyings las grub pa mo: dbyings phyug lha mo lnga la phyag 'tshal lo: rgyu 'bras byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa ste: mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo: ga ṇa pa ti'i sprul pa ste: ging pho rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: lha mo dpal mo'i sprul pa ste: ging mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jig rten khams la mnga' mdzad ma: 'jigs byed dpal 'bar ral pa can: 'dod pa'i ro la chags pa mo: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod cing: bka' bzhin rjes su bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzad ma: dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: a la la ho: bcom ldan 'das dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: ma nu pā lā ya: badz+ra satwa twe no pa: tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa: su to ṣ+yo me bha wa: su po ṣ+yo me bha wa: a nu rak+to me bha wa: sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha: sarba karma su tsa me: tsit+taṃ shre yāṃḥku ru hūm̐: ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga wān: sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca: badz+rī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa ā: dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi: yang snying yi ge brgya pa 'di: bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gam: brgya dang rtsa brgyad brjod gyur na: mtshams med lnga yi sdig pa byang: nyams chag kun kyang byang gyur nas: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis:

sras kyi dam par dgongs par 'gyur: ho: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dgongs: rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i lung: ji bzhin ma spyad lung dang 'gal: gsang sngags dam tshig nyams chag rnams: gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis ni: mi 'chab mi sbed mthol lo bshags: bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang: mched dang lcam dral la sogs pa: khams gsum sems can thams cad la: mtshams med lnga dang nye ba lnga: lci ba bzhi dang log pa brgyad: mi dge bcu yi las bgyis rnams: gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bshags par bgyi: gsang sngags phyi nang dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje slob dpon mched lcam la: ma gus nyes par byas la sogs: sku yi dam tshig nyams chag rnams: gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bshags par bgyi: bskyed rdzogs bzlas sgom bar chod cing: tshogs dang gtor ma chag la sogs: gsung gi dam tshig nyams chag rnams: gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bshags par bgyi: nyams dang ma smin sems can la: gsang ba bsgrags pa la sogs pa: thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag rnams: gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bshags par bgyi: spyad bya lnga dang mi spang lnga: blang bya lnga dang bsgrub bya lnga: shes par bya ba lnga la sogs: yan lag dam tshig nyams chag rnams: gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyi bshags par bgyi: nya stong tshes brgyad la sogs dus kyi mchod pa chag: bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin ma gsal lta ba log: phud dang gtsang sbra ma mchis 'bags btsog shor: le lo ser sna'i dbang du gyur pa rnams: gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bshags par bgyi: 'di nas bzung ste byang chub mchis kyi bar: sdig pa mi dge'i las su gyur pa kun: lus dang srog la bab kyang mi bgyid pa'i: rgyal ba khyed kyi spyan sngar dam 'cha' 'o: khyed kyi thugs rjes btang snyoms ma mdzad par: byams brtse ldan pas bu bzhin bskyang du gsol: de ltar mthol zhing bshags pa yis: bdag cag gsang sngags sgor zhugs rnams:

rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig gi: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: mchog dang thun mong la sogs te: dngos grub thams cad thob gyur cig: ta na ga ṇa'i lta spyod dbang: sems kyi rtogs pa thob gyur cig: de lta bu yi 'gyod tshangs kyis: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams: lus ngag yid gsum sgrib byang zhing: na rag gnas kyang dong sprugs nas: 'gro drug gnas nas thar gyur cig: lam lnga sa bcu'i rim pa rnams: skad cig nyid la bgrod gyur cig: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags: sangs rgyas sku gsum thob par shog: de las byung ba'i dge ba yis: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa rnams: bka' btsan byin che dar gyur cig: kun kyang sangs rgyas thob par shog: gsang sngags 'di bsgrags rgyal khams su: mi nad phyugs nad zhi gyur cig: mi dang lo phyugs legs gyur cig: dge 'dun dge bcu spyod gyur cig: ye dharmā he tu pra bha bāḥhe tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga te h+ya ba dat+ta/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha/ e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ye swā hā: zhes gsungs so: rnal 'byor gyi spyi khrus: na rag dong sprugs 'gyod tshangs kyi rgyal po: slob dpon pad+mas jo mo mtsho rgyal la thugs dam nar mar gdams pa'o: gsang sngags 'di lan gcig brjod pa tsam gyis kyang mtshams med pa lnga yang dung phyis pa ltar 'gyur zhes dgongs 'dus klong chen rgyud nas gsungs so: de bas 'di la yi dam byed pa gal che: sprul sku nyang gi gter ma'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
